title: Burdock and Gobo Casserole
description: A hearty and comforting dish from the Andes, featuring the earthy flavors of burdock and gobo roots. This recipe combines traditional Peruvian ingredients with a modern twist.
instructions: Peel and chop the gobo and burdock roots into 1-inch pieces.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped roots and cook until tender, about 20 minutes.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the zesty sauce ingredients.
Add the cooked roots to the bowl and toss with the zesty sauce until well combined.
Stir in the citrusy Peruvian corn kernels.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
